capabilities: (Switch) between visual and logical line modes
disambiguation: Not a full Emacs emulation, but a practical and stable subset of Emacs keybindings.
intentEvidence: This plugin provides a lightweight Emacs-style editing experience while respecting common Windows shortcuts as much as possible.
problem: Users who prefer Emacs keybindings for navigation and editing within Obsidian on Windows often lack native support.
summary: Provides Emacs-style keybindings for Obsidian, specifically optimized for Windows users, offering a lightweight editing experience.
